_readme: Generic site mapping: differences from the defaults, source-to-Cendyn mapping, and the section library. Copy to content-jobs/<site>/mapping.json and fill. Keep only what differs from references/defaults/. Fast path: run skills/cendyn-discovery/references/probe-sections.js once (all definitions), then compare two Hotel Overview-style pages for keep/copy roles. No client names, URLs or ids belong in this template.

<section_id>.roles: element slug = copy | keep | image | icon | empty  (needs 2 pages to tell keep from copy)

notes: Element suffixes in page forms are [elements][<elementId>] and [row_N][elements][<id>]; element ids belong to the section definition, so one suffix map serves every page using that section.
Element types seen on Cendyn CMS: string, editor, image (with size), link (name/url/menu_id/target), select, grid>row (repeater, min/max rows), widget (faq, rooms, gallery, categories).
Treat OUTDATED sections as read-only content sources.
